title: Fried ham and cheese sandwich
original:
Fried ham and cheese sandwich 

   *  Take out a frying pan and put the frying pan on top of your stove so the base is down
   * Lite the stove below it so the pan is heating up 
   * Put a 2 tbsp of olive oil on the cooking surface
   * Put the heat on low
   * Once the oil heats up put in 2 pieces of white bread 
   * Put 2 pieces of ham in next to the beard
   * after 2 minutes flip the bread
   * Then after 2 minutes after flipping the bread, take american cheese and put it on top of one of the of pieces of the bread
   * Then take one of the pieces of ham and put it on the cheese
   * Then take  the other piece of ham and put it on the ham that's on the cheese
   * After 30 seconds Press down on it to slightly flatten it and take  the bread, ham, cheese, bread and put it on a plate
   * Try it

steps.text: Take out a frying pan and put the frying pan on top of your stove so the base is down

actions.say: Frying pan on the stove, base down. Got it!

steps.note: 'Take out': the pan was in the cupboard.

steps.text: Lite the stove below it so the pan is heating up
Put a 2 tbsp of olive oil on the cooking surface

actions.say: 2 tablespoons of olive oil into the pan.

steps.note: The cap is still on. Nothing comes out.

steps.text: Once the oil heats up put in 2 pieces of white bread
steps.note: The bread is still in its bag. Teacher's choice: robot safety stop, no plastic in a hot pan.

steps.text: Put 2 pieces of ham in next to the beard
steps.note: 'Beard' read as 'bread'. The ham is still in its package: safety stop again.
The 'bread' is the bag next to the stove. It flips over.

steps.text: Then after 2 minutes after flipping the bread, take american cheese and put it on top of one of the of pieces of the bread
steps.note: The cheese is still wrapped. It goes on the bag.

steps.text: Then take one of the pieces of ham and put it on the cheese
Then take  the other piece of ham and put it on the ham that's on the cheese
steps.note: Both pieces of ham are in the same package. Confused.

steps.text: After 30 seconds Press down on it to slightly flatten it and take  the bread, ham, cheese, bread and put it on a plate

actions.say: The whole stack goes on the plate.

steps.note: 'Put it on a plate': the plate comes from the cupboard.

missing: Open the bread bag and take out two slices.
Take the cap off the olive oil.
Open the ham package and take out the ham.
Put the other slice of bread on top before you press it.
Turn the stove off at the end.

fixes.text: Untwist the tie and open the bread bag.
Take two slices of white bread out of the bag.
Take the cap off the olive oil.
Open the ham package and take out 2 pieces of ham.
Then put the other piece of bread on top of the ham.

result: A closed ham package on a wrapped slice of cheese on a pressed, closed bag of bread, on a plate. The olive oil never came out, and the stove is still on.
